stage: Targeted follow-up after actual event imbalance was established; no outcome-based model or fold selection
test: 8 chronological rounds, each with all 8 locations. Exclude adjacent chronological rounds from outer training. Inner leave-one-round tuning among remaining training rounds.
models: same + next location negative/control (author highpass is noncausal)
same-size physical current+history design with HRF mean4/6/8 chosen using only training
units: percent-signal-change raw anatomical ROI windows; all voxels retained, no main-task outcome selection
scope: Prediction of measured localizer windows and sensitivity of reference construction. This is not a test that cognitive SR is present or absent.
